packages.name: ArchiveOS Gaming Center

summary.tr: Oyun kitaplığı, başlatıcılar ve Windows oyun uyumluluğu.
summary.en: Game library, launchers and Windows game compatibility.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS game library and gaming tools
 Launch Linux, AppImage and Windows games. Import Steam and Heroic libraries.
 Install launchers, UMU and GE-Proton. Optimize games without stopping services.
packages.depends: python3 (>= 3.10), python3-pyqt6 (>= 6.5), flatpak, pkexec, systemd, util-linux, libglib2.0-bin

packages.name: ArchiveOS Terminal

summary.tr: Sekmeli KDE terminali ve klasör entegrasyonu.
summary.en: Tabbed KDE terminal with folder integration.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS Qt terminal
 Independent light-blue Qt interface with embedded KDE terminal sessions,
 tabs, search, clipboard shortcuts and Turkish/English localization.
packages.depends: python3 (>= 3.10), python3-pyqt6 (>= 6.5), konsole-kpart, libkf6parts6, libkf6coreaddons6, libkf6i18n6, libstdc++6, libc6 (>= 2.34), systemd

packages.name: ArchiveOS Touch Keyboard
packages.description:
ArchiveOS touchscreen keyboard for Plasma X11 and Wayland
 English and Turkish Q layouts selected from the system language.
 Onboard handles accessible X11 text fields and bottom docking.
 KWin and Maliit handle native Wayland text input and keyboard geometry.
packages.depends: python3 (>= 3.10), python3-pyqt6 (>= 6.5), python3-gi, gir1.2-glib-2.0, onboard, onboard-data, maliit-keyboard, at-spi2-core, libglib2.0-bin, libkf6config-bin, plasma-workspace, xkb-data, libxkbcommon0, qml6-module-qtquick-virtualkeyboard, libqt6virtualkeyboard6, qt6-virtualkeyboard-plugin, systemd

packages.name: Welcome to ArchiveOS

summary.tr: ArchiveOS karşılama, sistem ayarları ve uygulama kısayolları.
summary.en: ArchiveOS welcome, system settings and application shortcuts.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS welcome and system tools
 ArchiveOS welcome application with appearance, maintenance and package tools.
 Starts on installed desktop sessions by default; live sessions are excluded.
 Each user can disable automatic startup in the application.

packages.name: ArchiveOS Windows App Support

summary.tr: Wine ve Proton ile Windows uygulama desteği.
summary.en: Windows application support with Wine and Proton.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS Windows App Support
 ArchiveOS desktop utility with system-aware light and dark appearance.
 Turkish system locales use Turkish; other locales use English.
packages.depends: python3 (>= 3.10), python3-pyqt6 (>= 6.5), pkexec, apt, dpkg, flatpak, systemd

packages.name: About ArchiveOS
packages.description:
About ArchiveOS
 ArchiveOS desktop utility with system-aware light and dark appearance.
 Turkish system locales use Turkish; other locales use English.

packages.name: ArchiveStore

summary.tr: ArchiveOS uygulama mağazası; paketler, kaynaklar ve güncellemeler.
summary.en: ArchiveOS application store, software sources and updates.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS application store and integrated DEB installer
 Search apps from enabled APT repositories, browse categories and favorites,
 manage installed applications and updates, inspect and install local DEBs,
 manage Flatpak repositories and keep local operation history.
 ArchiveOS GitHub package source will be connected separately.
packages.depends: python3 (>= 3.10), python3-pyqt6 (>= 6.5), python3-pyqt6.qtsvg, python3-apt, python3-yaml, apt, dpkg, pkexec, systemd, libglib2.0-bin, libnotify-bin

packages.name: ArchiveOS Pomodoro

summary.tr: Odaklanma ve mola sayacı, günlük hedef ve geçmiş.
summary.en: Focus and break timer, daily goal and history.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS focus timer and break companion
 Native Qt focus timer with short and long breaks, configurable sessions,
 daily goals, weekly insights, local history and paused session recovery.
 Follows the system light/dark appearance and Turkish/English locale.

packages.name: Archive

summary.tr: Dinamik ada, hareketli gözler, müzik ve bildirimler.
summary.en: Dynamic island, animated eyes, music and notifications.

packages.description:
ArchiveOS animated desktop companion
 Animated eyes, expanding notifications, media playback controls,
 theme and language preferences for X11 and XWayland sessions.
packages.depends: libglib2.0-bin, python3, python3-pyqt6, python3-pyqt6.qtsvg, python3-dbus, dbus-bin, pipewire-bin, pulseaudio-utils, python3-gi, libxcb-cursor0
